workLog.action: Validated the dispatcher path before executing it, closing a Semgrep CWE-78 finding
workLog.outcome: Command injection was not reachable, since the interpreter is invoked as an argument list with no shell. The boundary was still worth making explicit for a different and real invariant: only the install root is caller supplied, and a symlink under hooks could point the interpreter at a script outside the install tree. Containment now refuses that. Negative control verified in both directions: removing the check makes the escaping-symlink test fail with DID NOT RAISE. No suppression was used, and annotating the loader return as ModuleType avoided a type-ignore the ratchet would have blocked.
